releases.name: v3.2.0 — SSH Agent Authentication
releases.body:
## Breaking Changes

- Bifrost **never reads private key files** — all authentication runs through ssh-agent
- Removed `keyDiscovery` config field
- Removed auto-discovery (`~/.ssh/` scanning)
- Requires ssh-agent running (`SSH_AUTH_SOCK` on Unix/Mac, Pageant/OpenSSH Agent on Windows)

## How It Works

- `keyPath` and `keys[]` in config are now used for **automatic `ssh-add`** before connecting
- `~/.ssh/config` IdentityFile mappings are also loaded into the agent
- ssh2 authenticates via the agent — key data never passes through Bifrost

## Key Resolution (ssh-add order)

| Priority | Source | Config field |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| 1 | Explicit single key | `keyPath` → `ssh-add <path>` |
| 2 | Explicit key list | `keys` → `ssh-add` each |
| 3 | SSH config | `~/.ssh/config` IdentityFile → `ssh-add` |

If none configured, agent must already have the key loaded.

## Cross-Platform Support

- **macOS/Linux**: Uses `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`
- **Windows**: Auto-detects Pageant when `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` is not set

releases.name: v3.1.0 — Per-Server Key Assignment & SSH Config
v3.0.0 — Multi-Server Support
releases.body:
## Breaking Changes
- Config format changed to support multiple named servers
- `BifrostManager` no longer uses singleton pattern
- All tools now accept optional `server` parameter

## New Features
- **Multi-server support** — define multiple named servers in config
- **Automatic SSH key discovery** from `~/.ssh/`
- **Key priority sorting** — ed25519 > ecdsa > rsa > dsa
- **BifrostRegistry** — manages multiple simultaneous connections
- **Backward-compatible** — legacy single-server config auto-migrates
- **Dynamic system prompt** — lists available servers + connection status

## Full Changelog
See [README](https://github.com/itsmylife44/bifrost/blob/main/README.md) for configuration examples and migration guide.
